feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 25 November 2026 9:15pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at 9:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Staying dry tonight, with variable amounts of cloud and moderate or fresh southeast winds. Minimum temperature around 3 or 4°C.

Comments: Nil.

Dry for much of the day tomorrow, then rain will arrive in the evening. The southeast winds will increase, becoming fresh to strong by about lunchtime, then possibly touch gale force around the northern and southern tips of the island by the end of the day. Maximum temperature 8°C.

Comments: Strong winds. Risk of gales in exposed areas later. Snowdonia providing some shelter, limiting the extent of gale force winds.


##Outlook##

Rain at first on Friday, heavy at times, but clearing during the morning, leaving the rest of the day generally dry with sunny/ clear intervals. The strong to gale force southeast winds will ease as the rain clears. Max temperature 9°C.

Comments: Strong to gale force winds and heavy rain at first. Risk of coastal overtopping (at ~00:35 hours).
